verdict.rationale: Stripe Financial Connections has a dedicated first-party webhooks page listing concrete events. These fire when a customer links a new account (one event per account) and when balance, ownership, or transaction refreshes complete, plus guidance on handling inactive accounts via the relink API. Together this gives a programmatic consumer a documented event-subscription surface. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of endpoint registration and signature-verification mechanics in the cited snippets, and independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook delivery.
